csv_scope_of_work: LCMHA is a public housing authority organized under the laws of the State of Ohio and is responsible for providing safe, decent, and affordable housing opportunities for low-income residents. The Housing Authority is seeking qualifications and proposals from experienced development firms or development teams to assist with an upcoming affordable housing development project located in Logan County. The Housing Authority is pursuing the development or redevelopment of affordable housing in Logan County. The project may include: Rehabilitation of existing affordable housing units; New construction of affordable housing units; Mixed-income housing; Senior housing; Family housing; Supportive housing; Community space, resident services space, or related improvements; Site infrastructure, accessibility improvements, energy efficiency upgrades, or other capital improvements.
